column1: # The checks of shell/disabled-form.nsh. See check-shell-log.sh.
# uefisettings disables the second form, whose CHECKBOX op is malformed, and names it with the IFR
# that it ignores; it reads the questions of the first form, and withholds the bytes of the
# PASSWORD of the second; the checks of the reason stop before its §, which the aarch64 console

column3: (.responses | length == 1 and .[0].question.answer == "1") and (.ignored_ifr | length == 1 and .[0].package_list == "8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001230" and .[0].offset == 136 and (.[0].reason | startswith("the form 2 of the FormSet 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001230, whose EFI_IFR_CHECKBOX op is malformed; UEFI 2.11 ")))

(.responses | length == 1 and (.[0].question.answer | startswith("<ValueUnavailable: its bytes hold a password>"))) and (.ignored_ifr | length == 1 and .[0].package_list == "8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001230" and .[0].offset == 136 and (.[0].reason | startswith("the form 2 of the FormSet 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001230, whose EFI_IFR_CHECKBOX op is malformed; UEFI 2.11 ")))

(.responses | length == 0) and (.ignored_ifr | length == 1 and .[0].package_list == "8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001230" and .[0].offset == 136 and (.[0].reason | startswith("the form 2 of the FormSet 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001230, whose EFI_IFR_CHECKBOX op is malformed; UEFI 2.11 ")))

^warning: questions may be in the IFR that uefisettings ignores at offset 136 of a form package of package list 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001230: the form 2 of the FormSet 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001230, whose EFI_IFR_CHECKBOX op is malformed;
^Disabled at offset 136: the form 2 of the FormSet 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001230, whose EFI_IFR_CHECKBOX op is malformed;

column1: # The PASSWORD of the disabled form is a setup password question, which no setup browser asks

column3: . == {"error_message": "this HiiDB declares a setup password question; the UEFI Shell runs no setup browser, so no password is asked or checked; pass --bypass-setup-password to write anyway"}

column1: # and no question of the disabled form is set

column3: .error_message | startswith("no question \"Disabled setting\" in the HiiDB, but it may be in the IFR that uefisettings ignores at offset 136 of a form package of package list 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001230: the form 2 of the FormSet 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001230, whose EFI_IFR_CHECKBOX op is malformed; UEFI 2.11 ")
